title: Test weak Lefschetz behavior of a monomial complete intersection

source.citation: A note on the weak Lefschetz property of monomial complete intersections in positive characteristic, arXiv:1003.0824

translation.notes: For `K[x,y,z]/(x^4,y^4,z^4)`, the middle multiplication map by `x+y+z` is built explicitly over five prime fields. Its rank drops precisely in the paper’s exceptional characteristics 2 and 5.
